text:
FinSight Labs — a fast-growing fintech startup building analytics and automation tools that help SMBs make smarter cash and growth decisions. We combine real-time data, clean modeling, and product-first UX to turn messy finance into confident strategy.

What you'll do
- Build, maintain, and improve financial models and dashboards to support revenue forecasting, cash flow analysis, and scenario planning.
- Lead monthly and quarterly FP&A cycles: prepare management packs, variance analysis, and actionable insights for leadership.
- Partner with Sales, Product, and Ops to translate business drivers into numbers and to track KPIs against targets.
- Run ad hoc financial analysis to evaluate pricing, new features, GTM experiments, and strategic initiatives.
- Help operationalize planning processes, improve forecasting accuracy, and document model logic and assumptions.

What we need (mandatory)
- Financial Modeling
- FP&A
- 3-6 years experience

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- SAP FICO
- Budgeting

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Hyderabad, 3 days a week in the office.
